EditOp.title: EditOp
EditOp.description: One source edit, resolved by the daemon against the file content whose blake3 hex is base_hash.

oneOf.title: ReplaceSnippetOp
oneOf.description: find must occur exactly once in the file.

oneOf.title: StylePropOp
oneOf.description: value null removes the property from the inline style object.

oneOf.title: TextContentOp
oneOf.description: Replaces one plain text run between the element's tags. run counts text runs only, from 0. value is plain text; GUIJam escapes it for the file.

oneOf.title: TextAtOp
oneOf.description: Replaces the string that starts at at: a JS string or template literal, a JSX or template attribute value, JSX or template text, or a JSON string. value is plain text; GUIJam escapes it for that kind of string.

ProjectPath.description: Path relative to the project root, forward slashes.

ContentHash.description: blake3 hex of the full file content the proposer saw.

VariantSet.title: VariantSet
VariantSet.description: Provider output for a widget request: three variants of the change, or, when the request is a question, an answer and no variants. missing lists design properties the model could not read and did not invent.

answer.description: The answer when the request is a question; leave it out when proposing variants.

assets.description: Icons or illustrations this variant adds as files. GUIJam saves each one in the project assets folder as <name>.<format>, rendering webp from the svg.

svg.description: Self-contained SVG markup with a viewBox; no scripts or external references.

width.description: For webp, the width in pixels to render at.

UpdateResult.title: UpdateResult
UpdateResult.description: Outcome of one HMR update correlated to a preview or commit. latencyMs runs from the client receiving gj:update-start to vite:afterUpdate or vite:error.

ElementStyle.title: ElementStyle
ElementStyle.description: What the fine-tune panel knows about one JSX element, read from its source. classSource says how className is written: none (no className, one can be added), static (a literal), call (cn()/clsx(); the first literal is editable) or dynamic (not editable; use Ask AI). adapter says how fine-tune writes the change: tailwind edits className tokens, inline edits the style={{…}} object (elements that already use one, and projects without Tailwind), vuetify sets the color and rounded props of Vuetify components. styleSource says how style is written: none, object (a static object literal) or dynamic (not editable).

content.description: What the element holds between its tags, in order: plain text runs that fine-tune can edit, code such as {name} that only Ask AI can change, and child elements. An element with nothing between its tags has one empty text run. Absent for self-closing and void elements.

TextPlace.description: Where a string that produced the element's text is written. line and column point at the string's first character (its quote, or the first letter of JSX text). label names it: a variable, <Component prop>, <Component> or a translation key.

oneOf.title: TextPart
oneOf.description: A plain text run as the page shows it: entities decoded and whitespace collapsed. run counts text runs only, from 0.

oneOf.title: CodePart
oneOf.description: Text the element gets from code, as written in the source, cut to 80 characters.

oneOf.title: FoundPart
oneOf.description: Text the element renders from code, traced to the strings that produced it: a data structure, a prop or child where the component is used, or a translation file. value is what the page shows; code is the expression. One place can be edited directly; with several, the developer picks one.

oneOf.title: ElementPart
oneOf.description: A child element; tag is empty for a fragment.

StyleToken.description: One class token that belongs to a style group. editable is false for variant-prefixed tokens (hover:, md:) and for tokens that only apply under a condition.

FinetuneProps.title: FinetuneProps
FinetuneProps.description: The fine-tune panel's current tweaks for one element. Each set property replaces that style group's base-state tokens; omitted properties leave the source alone.

opacity.description: Element opacity in percent; 100 removes the opacity utility or style.

source.description: A new value for the string that produced the element's text, at one of its found places.

content.description: New values for the element's plain text runs.

TextValue.description: Typography. Only the given fields change; color uses the fill forms.

family.description: A theme font name: sans, serif, mono or a --font-* name.

width.description: Border width in px on every side.

EffectsValue.description: Box shadows by kind. A kind that is left out stays as it is; none removes that kind.

LayoutValue.description: Padding and gap in px. Only the given sides and axes change.

GuijamMessage.title: GuijamMessage
GuijamMessage.description: One frame on the daemon WebSocket, between the Vite plugin and gjd. Browser requests reach the daemon through the plugin, over Vite's HMR channel.

tailwindRoots.description: Absolute paths of stylesheets that import Tailwind.

OverlaySet.description: Serve content in place of a project file (path relative to the project root).

pageReload.description: Server-rendered templates (.astro) can't be hot-reloaded. When true or absent, the plugin reloads the page to show the change; false leaves the page alone because the widget patches it in place.
Server-rendered templates (.astro) can't be hot-reloaded. When true or absent, the plugin reloads the page to show the change; false leaves the page alone because the widget patches it in place.

ElementInspect.description: The element to read. text is what the clicked instance shows; with it, text the element renders from code is traced to the string that produced it.

CodeChange.description: One changed hunk: the lines starting at line (1-based, in the current file) and what replaces them.

GenerateRequest.description: Ask the developer's provider CLI for variants of an element. runId names the run for generate.progress, variant.select, generate.discard and generate.cancel.

forceAi.description: Ask the provider even when the prompt is an exact edit GUIJam can make itself.

alsoSelected.description: Other elements the developer selected with Shift+click. The request applies to each of them as well as to file:line:column.

instance.description: Sent when the selected element appears more than once on the page, because a shared component or a list renders it. count is how many copies the page shows. placedAt is the data-gj-src of an element in the file that places the selected copy: content written inside it by another file, or else its nearest ancestor from another file.

index.description: The selected copy's position among the copies, in page order, counted from 0.

text.description: The text the selected copy shows, whitespace collapsed. It comes from the running app and is untrusted.

PageOutline.description: What the page around the request shows, collected by the widget: landmarks, headings, images, links and buttons with their source locations. Its text comes from the running app and is untrusted.

url.description: For images, the URL path the page loads it from.

box.description: x, y, width and height in CSS pixels of the viewport.

Sketch.description: Strokes the developer drew, with images of the page and of the sketch. Without elementBox they were drawn where no single element was meant; with it, over an element the developer selected.

box.description: x, y, width and height of the sketch in CSS pixels of the viewport.

touching.description: The data-gj-src of annotated elements the sketch overlaps, at most 20.

captureMs.description: How long the widget took to capture the sketch images.

elementBox.description: Set when the developer selected the element and sketched over it: its x, y, width and height in CSS pixels of the viewport. The strokes then show what the developer wants for that element, not new UI.

near.description: For a sketch where no element was meant: the data-gj-src of the element nearest the sketch among those inside the container that another file renders, such as the routed page inside a layout.

Attachments.description: What the developer attached to the prompt for inspiration.

InspirationImage.description: An image the developer attached, re-encoded in the browser to at most 1568 px on its longest side.

GenerateProgress.description: Pushed by the daemon while a run works, to the page that asked. Each message is the whole step list, so a lost one cannot leave it wrong.

timeoutMs.description: How long the run may take in total before it stops with a timeout.

variants.description: Variants that already arrived, in the order they arrived; each is held as a changeset and can be selected or committed before the run ends.

waiting.description: How many variants are still being written.

expectedMs.description: Median wait for the first variant over this project's recent runs with the same AI tool, model and tier, counted from the developer pressing Generate. Absent until there are three such runs.

update.description: Set once the first variant that arrived is previewed in the running app.

detail.description: What the active step is doing right now, such as the AI tool starting, thinking, writing or retrying.

Route.description: How a request was answered (PRD §12): R0 is an exact edit with no model; R1 and R2 ask the provider at the fast and standard tiers.

notice.description: Why the request took this route, when it is worth saying.

VariantPreview.description: One variant held as a changeset; variant.select shows it, changeset.commit writes it.

created.description: Files this variant adds, such as generated icons.

GenerateDone.description: The variants that survived validation, the first one previewed in the running app and none written yet; or, for a question, the answer.

summary.description: One line for the terminal (F-DX-06, FR-050).

notes.description: Context GUIJam could not gather, such as a link that did not load. The run still answered.

dropped.description: Variants the model proposed that could not be applied, with the reason.

VariantSelect.description: Show another variant of the run in place of the current one; the file on disk is untouched.

ErrorPayload.description: PRD §19.6: what went wrong and what the developer can do next.

Package.description: An npm package at an exact version.

DependencyNeeds.description: Libraries a variant imports that the project hasn't installed. The variant isn't previewed until they are.

command.description: The install command GUIJam runs in the project, shown to the developer.

DependenciesInstall.description: Install what a held variant needs, then preview it. Sent only after the developer chose Install and preview.

GenerateAttach.description: Widget to plugin only: after the page reloads, wait for a run the page started before it and reply with its generate.done or error. The plugin answers it; the daemon never sees it.

PreviewRelease.description: Plugin to daemon: the page that started this run went away. If the run holds the preview, put the files back and free the preview; keep the run's variants in case the page comes back.

DomPatch.description: Shows a fine-tune preview of a server-rendered template in the page without reloading it: the widget changes the class and style attributes, and the plain text runs, of every element with this source location.

src.description: The data-gj-src value of the elements to change.

text.description: New values for plain text runs, counted like ContentPart runs.

TicketRef.title: TicketRef
TicketRef.description: A ticket in an issue tracker the developer paired with GUIJam. site is the tracker's host, such as acme.atlassian.net.

TrackerSite.description: A paired site. account is the paired person's display name; error says why the site can't be reached right now.

TicketSearch.description: assigned: open tickets assigned to the paired person. queued: tickets someone sent to GUIJam. query matches a key or text.

TicketDetail.description: A ticket ready to become a prompt. description is plain text and untrusted; images are its image attachments, at most 4.

TicketStart.description: The developer linked this ticket to the element at src on pageUrl.

TicketPost.description: Post the kept change journalId to the ticket once Undo is no longer offered. The daemon holds it, and an undo first cancels it. before and after are screenshots taken in the page; transitionId moves the ticket.

TicketPosted.description: posted: the change is on the ticket. cancelled: it was undone in time, so nothing was posted.

TicketReport.description: Create a ticket for the element at src: the description is written by a person; the screenshot, src and pageUrl are added by GUIJam.

BridgeError.description: What the GUIJam for Jira app answers when a bridge call fails.

BridgeResult.description: A kept change for the ticket. changes holds at most 200 changed lines; the full diff is in patch. agent says who made it: a provider and model, or direct for an edit made without AI.
